lc_person: John P. McKay, University of Illinois historian; author of Pioneers for Profit (1970) and coauthor of A History of Western Society.
item_person: John P. McKay, University of Illinois historian with a Berkeley doctorate; Q5982019 links LC n79039574 but gives an unsupported 1948 birth year.

evidence.says: LC authorizes McKay, John P.; records birth year 1938; cites Pioneers for profit (1970) and A history of Western society (1995), whose author note identifies him as a University of Illinois history professor.

The item names John P. McKay, historian; lists the University of Illinois as employer, Berkeley as an educational institution, the 1970 Herbert Baxter Adams Prize, and LC identifier n79039574. Its 1948 birth year is sourced to Freebase Data Dumps.

The News-Gazette obituary identifies John Patrick McKay as a retired Illinois history professor born in 1938. He earned his Berkeley Ph.D. in 1968; his dissertation became Pioneers for Profit, which won the Herbert Baxter Adams Prize in 1970.

History @ Illinois (Spring 2023), page 15, memorial by Peter Fritzsche: John Patrick McKay was born in 1938, earned his Berkeley Ph.D. in 1968, taught at Illinois, and wrote Pioneers for Profit: Foreign Entrepreneurship and Russian Industrialization, 1885–1913 (1970).

notes: The graph dissertation matches the Berkeley doctorate year and the subject and dates of the resulting book. LC, the newspaper obituary, and the university memorial agree on 1938. The Wikidata birth year appears erroneous; its other identifying details agree with LC. Retain Q5982019.
